journey.name: ED-01 The create form opens empty with Save disabled
journey.description:
Covers FR-02. The FAB navigates to Route.TaskEditor(taskId = null), which is create mode: an empty form, priority defaulting to Medium, and Save disabled until a title exists.
Save being disabled is an affordance only. The rule itself lives in SaveTaskUseCase, which is what ED-02 probes.
Create mode makes no source call on open, so nothing here can lose a coin flip - but a save does, which is why the dice are off.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Verify that the title "New task" is on screen
Verify that "Edit task" is not on screen
Verify that the "Title" field is empty
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field is empty
Verify that the "Medium" priority chip is selected and that "Low" and "High" are not
Verify that "No due date" is on screen
Verify that the "Save" button is disabled
Verify that the "Save" button is now enabled
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen
Verify that "Buy milk" is on screen
